clock.sample: held-out frames, exact date and time: 115/115 (day-61 mornings), then a fresh blind sample of 60 frames from #382 lineage 1: 60/60. That sample was drawn with seed 382 (15 from lh1a1, 10 from lh1a2, 35 from lh1a3) from the 233 frames whose sidebar 'Time:' label pixel-matches an unobstructed template, so it covers unobstructed clocks only: 38 of lineage 1's 275 clock readings come from frames where a popup overlaps the label, and none of those is in the sample. It holds 12 day-61 mornings, 37 day-61 afternoons, 3 evenings (6:17, 7:42 and 7:50 PM) and 8 day-62 mornings.
clock.note: Night clock reading is narrowed, not closed: no held-out frame falls between 7:50 PM and 6:00 AM. From 7:50 to 10:30 PM menus covered the clock while the survivor tried to fall asleep, and from 10:30 PM to 6:00 AM it slept in one decision. The lead checked these frames as ground truth, outside the held-out counts, all exact: 10:30:00 PM day 61 (falling asleep), 6:00:58 AM day 62 (the rollover), 8:08:44 AM day 62 (the day point; another frame of that second is held-out f021) and 1:53:29 PM day 61. The sample's seed, filter and frame list are kept with lineage 1's archive (archive/20261107T040233-lineage1-end/validation3 in the sealed study 372-382-dev-loop-operator; originally .runtime/dev-loop/).
